SELECT DISTINCT a.id as assignment_id, a.type as assignment_type, GROUP_CONCAT(asub.id ORDER BY asub.id) as submission_ids, asub.session_id, asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id,
-- Student/Group info CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN su.user_name WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN sg.group_name ELSE 'Unknown' END as entity_name,
-- Group member count for GROUP/MIX assessments CASE WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_student_group sgm WHERE sgm.group_id = asub.subject_id ) ELSE NULL END as group_member_count,
-- Session timing info ss.start_at as session_start_at, ss.end_at as session_end_at,
-- Venue info ss.venue_id as session_venue_id, v.room_name as venue_name,
-- Release status derived from assessment_submission.release_status CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN asub.release_status = 'RELEASED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'RELEASED' ELSE 'NOT_RELEASED' END as release_status, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN asub.release_mode IS NOT NULL THEN asub.release_mode END), 'FULL') as release_mode,
-- Examiner progress aggregates COUNT(DISTINCT asub.examiner_id) as total_examiner_count, SUM(CASE WHEN asub.status = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as submitted_examiner_count, SUM(CASE WHEN asub.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draft_examiner_count, SUM(CASE WHEN asub.status = 'REOPENED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as reopened_examiner_count, MAX(asub.submitted_at) as last_submitted_at, MAX(CASE WHEN asub.release_status = 'RELEASED' THEN asub.updated_at END) as last_released_at, MAX(asub.updated_at) as last_updated_at,
-- Final score override info asub.final_score_override as final_score_override_pct, asub.override_reason as final_score_override_reason, asub.override_at as final_score_override_at, asub.override_by_user_id as final_score_override_by
FROM assignment a JOIN assessment_submission asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id LEFT JOIN slot_sessions ss ON asub.session_id = ss.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON ss.venue_id = v.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_group sg ON asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id
WHERE a.id = #{assignmentId}
AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId}
AND asub.release_status = 'RELEASED'
AND (asub.release_status != 'RELEASED' OR asub.release_status IS NULL)
AND ( (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND ( su.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR asub.subject_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) OR (asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND ( sg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR asub.subject_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) )
GROUP BY a.id, asub.session_id, asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id, entity_name, group_member_count, asub.final_score_override, asub.override_reason, asub.override_at, asub.override_by_user_id, ss.start_at, ss.end_at, ss.venue_id, v.room_name
HAVING 1 = 1
AND submitted_examiner_count = total_examiner_count AND total_examiner_count > 0 AND reopened_examiner_count = 0
AND reopened_examiner_count > 0
AND ( total_examiner_count = 0 OR (submitted_examiner_count < total_examiner_count AND reopened_examiner_count = 0) )
ORDER BY entity_name
LIMIT #{limit}
OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id, COUNT(DISTINCT asub.examiner_id) as total_examiner_count, SUM(CASE WHEN asub.status = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as submitted_examiner_count, SUM(CASE WHEN asub.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draft_examiner_count, SUM(CASE WHEN asub.status = 'REOPENED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as reopened_examiner_count FROM assignment a JOIN assessment_submission asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_group sg ON asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id
WHERE a.id = #{assignmentId}
AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId}
AND asub.release_status = 'RELEASED'
AND (asub.release_status != 'RELEASED' OR asub.release_status IS NULL)
AND ( (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND ( su.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR asub.subject_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) OR (asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND ( sg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR asub.subject_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) )
GROUP BY asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id
HAVING 1 = 1
AND submitted_examiner_count = total_examiner_count AND total_examiner_count > 0 AND reopened_examiner_count = 0
AND reopened_examiner_count > 0
AND ( total_examiner_count = 0 OR (submitted_examiner_count < total_examiner_count AND reopened_examiner_count = 0) )
) AS assessment_counts

SELECT a.id as assignment_id, a.type as assignment_type, a.name as assignment_name, a.rubric_meta_info, a.rubrics_info,
asub.session_id, asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id, asub.id as submission_id, asub.status as status, asub.release_status as release_status,
-- Session timing info ss.start_at as session_start_at, ss.end_at as session_end_at,
-- Venue info ss.venue_id as session_venue_id, v.room_name as venue_name,
-- Student/Group info CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN su.user_name WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN sg.group_name ELSE 'Unknown' END as entity_name,
CASE WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_student_group sgm WHERE sgm.group_id = asub.subject_id ) ELSE NULL END as group_member_count,
-- Final score override info asub.final_score_override as final_score_override_pct, asub.override_reason as final_score_override_reason, asub.override_at as final_score_override_at, asub.override_by_user_id as final_score_override_by,
-- Consolidated feedback from all examiners ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN asub_all.overall_feedback IS NOT NULL AND asub_all.overall_feedback != '' THEN CONCAT('Examiner ', u.user_name, ': ', asub_all.overall_feedback) ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR '\n\n' ) FROM assessment_submission asub_all LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON asub_all.examiner_id = u.user_id WHERE asub_all.assignment_id = asub.assignment_id AND asub_all.subject_type = asub.subject_type AND asub_all.subject_id = asub.subject_id AND asub_all.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND asub_all.overall_feedback IS NOT NULL AND asub_all.overall_feedback != '' ) as consolidated_feedback,
-- Admin notes (get from any submission, they should be consistent) asub.admin_note as admin_notes
FROM assignment a JOIN assessment_submission asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id LEFT JOIN slot_sessions ss ON asub.session_id = ss.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON ss.venue_id = v.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_group sg ON asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id
WHERE asub.id = #{submissionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT asub.id as submission_id, asub.examiner_id, asub.status as assessment_status, asub.submitted_at, asub.total_score, asub.overall_feedback, asub.admin_note as notes, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot, asub.rubrics_info_snapshot, asub.scores_json,
-- Examiner info u.user_name as examiner_name
FROM assessment_submission asub JOIN sys_user u ON asub.examiner_id = u.user_id
WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId} AND asub.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND asub.subject_id = #{subjectId}
ORDER BY asub.examiner_id

SELECT asub.id as submission_id, asub.examiner_id, asub.status as assessment_status, asub.submitted_at, asub.total_score, asub.overall_feedback, asub.admin_note as notes, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot, asub.rubrics_info_snapshot, asub.scores_json,
-- Examiner info u.user_name as examiner_name
FROM assessment_submission asub JOIN sys_user u ON asub.examiner_id = u.user_id
WHERE asub.id = #{submissionId} AND asub.examiner_id = #{examinerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment SET results_released = CASE WHEN #{releaseStatus} = 'RELEASED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, results_released_at = CASE WHEN #{releaseStatus} = 'RELEASED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{assignmentId}
UPDATE assignment SET is_released = #{released}, released_at = CASE WHEN #{released} = TRUE THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{assignmentId}

UPDATE assessment_submission SET final_score_override = #{finalScore}, override_reason = #{reason}, override_by_user_id = #{userId}, override_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( -- For individual assessments, update the specific student's submissions (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'INDIVIDUAL') OR -- For group assessments, update all submissions for group members (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP' AND subject_id IN ( SELECT sg.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg WHERE sg.group_id = #{subjectId} )) OR -- Also update the group-level submission if it exists (GROUP or MIX) (subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} IN ('GROUP', 'MIX')) )

UPDATE assessment_submission a1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT assignment_id, subject_id, subject_type FROM assessment_submission WHERE id = #{submissionId} LIMIT 1 ) a2 ON a1.assignment_id = a2.assignment_id AND a1.subject_id = a2.subject_id AND a1.subject_type = a2.subject_type SET a1.final_score_override = #{finalScore}, a1.override_reason = #{reason}, a1.override_by_user_id = #{userId}, a1.override_at = NOW(), a1.updated_at = NOW()

UPDATE assessment_submission SET release_status = #{releaseStatus}, release_mode = #{releaseMode}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( -- For individual assessments, update the specific student's submissions (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'INDIVIDUAL') OR -- For group assessments, update all submissions for group members (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP' AND subject_id IN ( SELECT sg.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg WHERE sg.group_id = #{subjectId} )) OR -- Also update the group-level submission if it exists (GROUP or MIX) (subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} IN ('GROUP', 'MIX')) )

UPDATE assessment_submission SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( -- For individual assessments, update the specific student's submissions (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'INDIVIDUAL') OR -- For group assessments, update all submissions for group members (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP' AND subject_id IN ( SELECT sg.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg WHERE sg.group_id = #{subjectId} )) OR -- Also update the group-level submission if it exists (GROUP or MIX) (subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} IN ('GROUP', 'MIX')) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN asub.subject_id WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN sg.user_id ELSE NULL END ) as student_count FROM assessment_submission asub LEFT JOIN sys_student_group sg ON asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( -- For individual assessments, count the specific student (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'INDIVIDUAL') OR -- For group assessments, count all group members (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP' AND asub.subject_id IN ( SELECT sg2.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg2 WHERE sg2.group_id = #{subjectId} )) OR -- For group-level submissions, count all group members (asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' AND asub.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP') )

SELECT a.id as assignment_id, a.name as assignment_name, su.user_id as subject_id, su.user_name as subject_name, 'INDIVIDUAL' as subject_type, NULL as member_count FROM assignment a JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = #{studentId} WHERE a.id = #{assignmentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id as assignment_id, a.name as assignment_name, sg.group_id as subject_id, sg.group_name as subject_name, 'GROUP' as subject_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_student_group sgm WHERE sgm.group_id = sg.group_id) as member_count FROM assignment a JOIN sys_group sg ON sg.group_id = #{groupId} WHERE a.id = #{assignmentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT asub.id as submission_id, asub.examiner_id, asub.status as assessment_status, asub.submitted_at, asub.total_score, asub.overall_feedback, asub.admin_note as notes, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot, asub.rubrics_info_snapshot, asub.scores_json, asub.session_id, asub.final_score_override, asub.override_reason, asub.override_at, asub.override_by_user_id,
-- Examiner info u.user_name as examiner_name
FROM assessment_submission asub JOIN sys_user u ON asub.examiner_id = u.user_id
WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = #{studentId}
ORDER BY asub.session_id, asub.examiner_id

SELECT asub.id as submission_id, asub.examiner_id, asub.status as assessment_status, asub.submitted_at, asub.total_score, asub.overall_feedback, asub.admin_note as notes, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot, asub.rubrics_info_snapshot, asub.scores_json, asub.session_id, asub.final_score_override, asub.override_reason, asub.override_at, asub.override_by_user_id,
-- Examiner info u.user_name as examiner_name
FROM assessment_submission asub JOIN sys_user u ON asub.examiner_id = u.user_id
WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND ( -- Direct group submissions (asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub.subject_id = #{groupId}) OR -- Individual submissions from group members (for MIX type assignments) (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id IN ( SELECT sg.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg WHERE sg.group_id = #{groupId} )) )
ORDER BY asub.session_id, asub.examiner_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ss.session_id) FROM slot_sessions ss JOIN assessment_submission asub ON ss.session_id = asub.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON ss.venue_id = v.id WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
AND ( DATE_FORMAT(ss.start_at, '%Y-%m-%d') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(ss.start_at, '%H:%i') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR v.room_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )

SELECT -- Normalize MIX type to GROUP for consistent handling CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'MIX' THEN 'GROUP' ELSE asub.subject_type END as subject_type, asub.subject_id,
-- Group fields (MIX is treated as GROUP) CASE WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN asub.subject_id ELSE NULL END as group_id, CASE WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN sg.group_name ELSE NULL END as group_name, CASE WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_student_group sgm WHERE sgm.group_id = asub.subject_id ) ELSE NULL END as member_count, CASE WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'studentId', sgm.user_id, 'name', su_member.user_name ) ) FROM sys_student_group sgm JOIN sys_user su_member ON sgm.user_id = su_member.user_id WHERE sgm.group_id = asub.subject_id ) ELSE NULL END as members_json,
-- Individual fields CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN asub.subject_id ELSE NULL END as student_id, CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN su.user_name ELSE NULL END as student_name, CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN ss.student_number ELSE NULL END as student_number,
-- Release status (check if any submission for this entity is released) CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN asub.release_status = 'RELEASED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'RELEASED' ELSE 'NOT_RELEASED' END as release_status, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN asub.release_mode IS NOT NULL THEN asub.release_mode END), 'FULL') as release_mode
FROM assessment_submission asub LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_student ss ON asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = ss.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_group sg ON asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id
WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId} -- For MIXED assignments, only show GROUP/MIX records to avoid duplicates -- (INDIVIDUAL records for group members are excluded as they're in members_json) AND ( asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') OR ( asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assessment_submission asub2 WHERE asub2.assignment_id = asub.assignment_id AND asub2.session_id = asub.session_id AND asub2.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub2.examiner_id = asub.examiner_id ) ) )
AND asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX')
AND asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
AND ( (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND ( su.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR ss.student_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) OR (asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND ( sg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) )
GROUP BY asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id, sg.group_name, su.user_name, ss.student_number
HAVING
release_status = 'RELEASED'
release_status = 'NOT_RELEASED'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') THEN sg.group_name ELSE su.user_name END
LIMIT #{limit}
OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(asub.subject_type, '_', asub.subject_id)) FROM assessment_submission asub LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_student ss ON asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = ss.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_group sg ON asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id
WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId} -- For MIXED assignments, only show GROUP/MIX records to avoid duplicates -- (INDIVIDUAL records for group members are excluded as they're in members_json) AND ( asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') OR ( asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assessment_submission asub2 WHERE asub2.assignment_id = asub.assignment_id AND asub2.session_id = asub.session_id AND asub2.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub2.examiner_id = asub.examiner_id ) ) )
AND asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX')
AND asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
AND ( (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND ( su.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR ss.student_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) OR (asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND ( sg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) )

SELECT a.id as assignment_id, a.name as assignment_name, a.type as assignment_type,
-- Take session info from first submission asub.session_id, ss.start_at as session_start_at, ss.end_at as session_end_at, ss.venue_id, v.room_name as venue_name,
-- Group info sg.group_id, sg.group_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_student_group sgm WHERE sgm.group_id = sg.group_id) as member_count, ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'studentId', sgm.user_id, 'name', su_member.user_name ) ) FROM sys_student_group sgm JOIN sys_user su_member ON sgm.user_id = su_member.user_id WHERE sgm.group_id = sg.group_id ) as members_json,
-- Release status CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN asub.release_status = 'RELEASED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'RELEASED' ELSE 'NOT_RELEASED' END as release_status, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN asub.release_mode IS NOT NULL THEN asub.release_mode END), 'FULL') as release_mode,
-- Rubric snapshot (from first submission) asub.rubric_meta_snapshot
FROM assignment a JOIN assessment_submission asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id JOIN sys_group sg ON sg.group_id = #{groupId} LEFT JOIN slot_sessions ss ON asub.session_id = ss.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON ss.venue_id = v.id
WHERE a.id = #{assignmentId} AND ( (asub.subject_type IN ('GROUP', 'MIX') AND asub.subject_id = #{groupId}) OR (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id IN ( SELECT sgm.user_id FROM sys_student_group sgm WHERE sgm.group_id = #{groupId} )) )
GROUP BY a.id, a.name, a.type, asub.session_id, ss.start_at, ss.end_at, ss.venue_id, v.room_name, sg.group_id, sg.group_name, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id as assignment_id, a.name as assignment_name, a.type as assignment_type,
-- Take session info from first submission asub.session_id, ss_slot.start_at as session_start_at, ss_slot.end_at as session_end_at, ss_slot.venue_id, v.room_name as venue_name,
-- Individual info su.user_id as student_id, su.user_name as student_name, stud.student_number,
-- Release status CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN asub.release_status = 'RELEASED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'RELEASED' ELSE 'NOT_RELEASED' END as release_status, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN asub.release_mode IS NOT NULL THEN asub.release_mode END), 'FULL') as release_mode,
-- Rubric snapshot (from first submission) asub.rubric_meta_snapshot
FROM assignment a JOIN assessment_submission asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = #{studentId} LEFT JOIN sys_student stud ON stud.user_id = #{studentId} LEFT JOIN slot_sessions ss_slot ON asub.session_id = ss_slot.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON ss_slot.venue_id = v.id
WHERE a.id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = #{studentId}
GROUP BY a.id, a.name, a.type, asub.session_id, ss_slot.start_at, ss_slot.end_at, ss_slot.venue_id, v.room_name, su.user_id, su.user_name, stud.student_number, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot LIMIT 1
